title: Bat Duel
brief: Two bats, one on the left edge and one on the right, knock a ball back and forth. The player moves the left bat up and down; the computer moves the right one. A point when the ball passes a bat.
level columns: ball speed | computer bat speed | bat height | points to win
layout legend: . empty, # wall block the ball bounces off, o ball start

title: Wall Breaker
brief: A bat at the bottom keeps a ball in play; the ball knocks out rows of bricks at the top. Clear every brick to finish the level; lose a life when the ball falls past the bat.
level columns: ball speed | bat width | brick rows | lives
layout legend: . empty, B brick, S strong brick (two hits), # solid wall

title: Long Worm
brief: A worm moves one cell at a time on a grid and never stops; the arrows turn it. Eating food makes it one cell longer. Hitting a wall or its own body ends the life.
level columns: steps per move | food to finish | start length | walls
layout legend: . empty, # wall, F food, W worm start

title: Sky Raiders
brief: Rows of raiders march sideways across the top and step down at each edge. The player's cannon slides along the bottom and fires one shot at a time; the raiders drop shots back. Clear the rows before they reach the bottom.
level columns: raider rows | raider speed | raider shot chance | shields
layout legend: . empty, R raider, T tough raider (two hits), = shield, A cannon start

title: Vine Run
brief: A runner crosses a jungle floor from left to right, screen by screen. Jump over pits and rolling logs, swing over water on a vine, pick up treasure. Falling in a pit costs a life.
level columns: pits | logs | log speed | treasures | time limit
layout legend: . empty, _ ground, P pit, L log, V vine, T treasure, R runner start

title: Rock Field
brief: A ship in the middle of the screen turns, thrusts and fires. Big rocks drift across; a shot splits a big rock into two small ones. Objects leaving one edge come back on the other.
level columns: big rocks | rock speed | small rocks per split | lives
layout legend: . empty, O big rock, o small rock, A ship start

title: Cross Traffic
brief: A walker hops one lane at a time from the bottom of the screen to the top, across lanes of traffic moving left or right at different speeds. Reach the top to score; being hit costs a life.
level columns: lanes | car speed | cars per lane | time limit
layout legend: . empty, > car going right, < car going left, = safe strip, W walker start, H home

title: Dot Maze
brief: The player moves through a maze of corridors collecting every dot while two chasers follow. Touching a chaser costs a life; collecting all the dots finishes the level.
level columns: chasers | chaser speed | player speed | dots
layout legend: # wall, . dot, C chaser start, M player start,   (space) empty

title: Stack Down
brief: Shapes made of four blocks fall one at a time into a well. The arrows slide and turn the falling shape. A full row disappears and scores; the game ends when the well fills to the top.
level columns: steps per drop | rows to finish | start junk rows | points per row
layout legend: . empty, # junk block already in the well

title: Soft Landing
brief: A lander falls slowly under gravity over rough ground. Left and right tilt thrust sideways, Up fires the main engine and burns fuel. Touch down on the flat pad slowly enough to score.
level columns: gravity | fuel | pad width | max landing speed
layout legend: . empty, ^ rock peak, _ flat ground, = landing pad, A lander start

title: City Shield
brief: Streaks fall from the top of the screen toward six city blocks along the bottom. The player moves an aiming cross and fires bursts that destroy any streak inside them. The level ends when the streaks run out; the game ends when every block is gone.
level columns: streaks | streak speed | bursts allowed | burst radius
layout legend: . empty, C city block, G gun base, v streak entry point

title: Deep Dive
brief: A diver moves in all four directions under water collecting pearls from the sea bed while fish cross the screen. Air runs down all the time and is refilled at the surface. Touching a fish or running out of air costs a life.
level columns: fish | fish speed | pearls | air seconds
layout legend: ~ surface, . water, f fish lane, p pearl, _ sea bed, D diver start
